mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pcd_space_table WHERE space_owner_id = #{ownerId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND space_status != 'deleted'

SELECT s.* FROM pcd_space_table s INNER JOIN pcd_space_member_table m ON s.space_id = m.space_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND s.space_status != 'deleted' ORDER BY s.space_created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM pcd_space_table WHERE space_type = 'public' AND space_visibility = 'public' AND space_status = 'active'
AND (space_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR space_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY space_created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM pcd_space_table WHERE space_name = #{spaceName} AND space_type = 'public' AND space_status = 'active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pcd_space_table (space_id, space_name, space_type, space_owner_id, space_quota, space_used, space_file_count, space_visibility, space_description, space_avatar_path, space_im_group_id, space_status) VALUES (#{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{spaceName}, #{spaceType}, #{spaceOwnerId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{spaceQuota}, #{spaceUsed}, #{spaceFileCount}, #{spaceVisibility}, #{spaceDescription}, #{spaceAvatarPath}, #{spaceImGroupId}, #{spaceStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_name = #{spaceName}, space_visibility = #{spaceVisibility}, space_description = #{spaceDescription}, space_avatar_path = #{spaceAvatarPath}, space_quota = #{spaceQuota} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_status = 'deleted' WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_quota = #{quota} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_used = space_used + #{size} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_used = GREATEST(0, space_used - #{size}) WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_file_count = space_file_count + #{count} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
UPDATE pcd_space_table SET space_file_count = GREATEST(0, space_file_count - #{count}) WHERE space_id = #{spaceId,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}
